note: International and government support for the Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi flood as the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers reports it on its rescue portal. Kept verbatim, including OPMCM's own currency conversions and cited sources. Not all of it reaches the Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund, and none of it is added to the portal's totals; contributions verified in the Fund's USD accounts are in foreign_assistance.csv. `aid_list_note` carries OPMCM's separate 'donor aid' list entry where it differs. Where OPMCM writes 'Rs', the portal writes 'NPR'; figures are untouched.

entries.detail_en: The Government of the Republic of Latvia — on a draft order submitted by the Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and approved by the Cabinet of Ministers on 8 September 2026 — provided EUR 100,000 in humanitarian assistance to Nepal to help mitigate the consequences of the Bhote Koshi / Rasuwa floods. The support is directed to search-and-rescue operations for missing persons, emergency assistance for those affected, and recovery from floods and landslides. Also in-kind support via the EU Civil Protection Mechanism (blankets, rescue helmets/lamps, forensic materials).
